narrative.overview: The app is the workbench of a print shop, and the clinic PDF is the proof lying on it. The desk is warm parchment. Sheets of white paper hold the forms. Ink-dark controls do the work, and a single gold mark points to whatever needs attention: focus, the active field, a section's start. The PDF preview is always the hero. The interface around it is tactile and warm, with paper-like surfaces, soft depth, and a firm press under every button, but it never competes with the clinic's own artwork. Density is calm rather than packed. Sales staff work on laptops and phones, so controls stay large (40-44px), labels are always visible, and the editor and preview sit side by side on desktop and swap with a tab on mobile. The admin side is the back office of the same shop: the standard neutral component theme in Geist, plainer and denser, with colour reserved for data.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment desk, white paper sheets, ink controls, one gold accent.
The PDF preview dominates; the UI chrome stays quieter than the clinic artwork.
Tactile feedback: soft paper shadows and a `scale(0.97)` press.
One typeface (Geist, with Noto Sans Arabic as fallback) across sales and admin. RTL is first-class.

rules.name: The One Gold Mark Rule
rules.body: Gold indicates attention: focus, the active field, the start of a section. Never use it as a button fill or a background wash. If two gold things compete on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Clinic Owns Colour Rule
rules.body: Brand colour belongs to the clinic artwork inside the PDF. The surrounding UI stays parchment, ink and gold, so the two clinics' identities never bleed into each other or into the chrome.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Tables and totals use tabular figures, so prices line up in their columns.

rules.name: The One Proof Rule
rules.body: The deep Proof shadow belongs to the PDF page alone. No other surface may be lifted that high.

dos: Do keep the PDF preview the largest, most elevated thing on screen.
Do use ink for action and gold only for attention (focus, active, section start).
Do give every pressable element `scale(0.97)` press feedback with the strong ease-out, kept under 300ms.
Do gate hover motion behind `@media (hover: hover)`.
Do keep touch targets at least 40px (44px for icon buttons) and labels visible above fields.
Do mirror layouts for RTL with logical properties (`ms-`, `me-`, `start-`).
donts: Don't use gradients, glow, glassmorphism or other flashy SaaS-marketing styling.
Don't introduce cold clinical/hospital blue into the sales interface.
Don't fill large areas or buttons with gold.
Don't let either clinic's brand colours leak into the shared chrome.
Don't use `transition: all` or hard-coded `100vh` offsets for pane heights.
